newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Aug-Oct stock market activity muted - Buba.
newsitem.headline: German Aug-Oct stock market activity muted - Buba.

text.p: German stock market activity, both issuance and turnover, was muted in the August to October period as the massive Deutsche Telekom flotation in November approached, the Bundesbank said in its December report.
Domestic companies sold shares worth 2.5 billion marks in the period, down from 4.9 billion in the year-ago period, and only three of the issues exceeded 100 million marks.

Domestic buyers dominated activity, with banks investing 2.7 billion marks and 1.7 billion marks in stocks. Non-banks were net sellers of domestic stocks and bought 3.3 billion marks in foreign shares, the report said.
Net bond sales rose to 54 billion marks from 52.4 billion the previous quarter.
Sales of domestic investment funds were little changed at 12.2 billion marks, compared with net sales of 11.6 billion marks the previous quarter.
